dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, prominent white band is visible on the greater coverts, showing high grayscale contrast and significant thickness against dark gray feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Tertial feathers exhibit sharp, high-contrast broad white edges; folded primaries show thinner, less distinct pale boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white outer rectrices create high-contrast margins along the length of the dark central tail feathers.
